name: AI Deep Dive — BTDR — 2026-05-02
rationale: Bitdeer (BTDR) is transitioning from pure Bitcoin mining into AI/HPC hosting. While revenue growth is spectacular (225%), the capital requirements are equally staggering, with $2.0B in negative FCF over the last 12 months. This requires massive shareholder dilution. Despite modeling a 100% share count increase in the base case, the sheer scale of HPC revenue potential yields a weighted fair value of $29.21, offering substantial upside if they execute their infrastructure pipeline.

aiThesis.rationale: Bitdeer presents a high-risk, high-reward infrastructure play. The company is burning cash at a terrifying rate (-$2.0B FCF) to build out its HPC and SEALMINER operations. To fund this at a $2.8B market cap, current shareholders will face severe dilution (I model 100% dilution in the base case). However, because they are trading at a relatively modest 4.6x trailing sales (compared to APLD's 66x), if they capture a fraction of the AI hosting market at 10% net margins, the equity has multi-bagger potential despite the dilution.
